title: Trading Between Countries Adventure
welcome_lead: Why does the UK buy bananas from Costa Rica? 🌍
meta_desc: Markets & Trade Adventure 2 — KS3 Economics on imports, exports and international trade.
final_note: You learned what imports and exports are and why countries trade with each other.

concepts.def: A good bought from another country
A good sold to another country
Imports cost more than exports earn

walkthroughs.body_html:
An import comes in. An export goes out.

UK imports: cars from Germany, bananas from Costa Rica, phones from China.

UK exports: cars from Sunderland, Scotch whisky, financial services. 🥃

Countries trade because of specialisation.

The UK can't grow pineapples cheaply. Costa Rica can. So we swap.

Each country does what it does best — total goods rise.

If exports > imports → trade surplus.

If imports > exports → trade deficit.

Governments sometimes add a tariff — a tax on imports — to help home businesses. 💷
